mutations.after: return storageRoots("outputRoot" in scope ? scope.tenant : scope);
mutations.because: a run's captured environment is ignored and its roots re-resolved from the process, so a report written after OUTPUT_DIR moved lands away from the run's assets (Qodo on #575).
